history.overview: The Camps serve as the Muramite staging area for warfront operations.

timeline.name: Camp Establishment
timeline.description: Muramite forces established barracks and supply lines.

timeline.name: Beast Deployment
timeline.description: Warbeasts were brought into the Camps for frontline support.

timeline.name: Resistance Infiltration
timeline.description: Resistance agents began covert sabotage operations.

timeline.name: Discord Flicker
timeline.description: Discord energy warped parts of the camp perimeter.
